body:
Independent Task B review of #139: **scoped PASS** for the C0-E1 compressed receipt correction. **Critical 0 / High 0 / Medium 0 / Low 0 new findings.** The pre-existing Low C0-E1 from #136 is reproduced before the correction and independently accepted as closed for the frozen target. This is not product-wide or release acceptance.

[REPORT](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/e7762952e18061de8c8235beaeddf42f20ad9f5a/docs/implementation/evidence/c0-e1-independent-20261023/REPORT.md), [findings.json](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/e7762952e18061de8c8235beaeddf42f20ad9f5a/docs/implementation/evidence/c0-e1-independent-20261023/findings.json), [commands](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/e7762952e18061de8c8235beaeddf42f20ad9f5a/docs/implementation/evidence/c0-e1-independent-20261023/COMMANDS.md), [measurements](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/e7762952e18061de8c8235beaeddf42f20ad9f5a/docs/implementation/evidence/c0-e1-independent-20261023/raw/boundaries/measurements.json).

## Exact target and independent evidence

- Reviewed #139 HEAD: `3e2609baa07a9e92c8f2dc4dd1608f311021a1cb`; tree: `43f0c017d5f922f7e1caf7e4a1605ec4ae7ace1c`.
- This PR directly targets `fix/c0-e1-receipt-limit-20261023`. Publication HEAD: `e7762952e18061de8c8235beaeddf42f20ad9f5a`; tree: `9c220c6606703aa36606896eb52d0a8966914a36`.
- A new non-Author Codex thread wrote an independent CLI experiment in a separate pinned checkout and disposable synthetic Git/artifact environment. Publication uses the connected owner's GitHub account; independence concerns implementation authorship/review work, not a different human account. No subagents or I6-A sibling changes were used.
- Live initial and prepublication GitHub/ref searches found no duplicate review. All **3,901 predecessor files remain unchanged**. The diff adds **64 evidence files only**, with **63 indexed payloads**. Source/tests/workflows, Accepted ADRs, Author evidence and existing audit PRs remain untouched.

| Actual closed DEFLATED ZIP bytes | Historical emitter exit | Fixed emitter exit | Fixed stdout bytes |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 2,097,151 | 0 | 0 | 3,285,724 |
| 2,097,152 | 0 | 0 | 3,285,724 |
| 2,097,153 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| 2,323,560 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| 18,795, expanded 6,120,583 | 0 | 0 | 29,625 |

These sizes come from real production ZIP construction after closure, by varying only synthetic input seed/length. No mocked length, patched ZIP writer, ZIP comment/padding or limit change is used. Construction-only calibration exit 99 is separate from final full CLI verdicts. CRC, all-DEFLATED members, exact index roster, hashes, synthetic binding, BEGIN/DATA/END and strict base64 verify. Refusals give explicit artifact fallback stderr and zero stdout; inputs stay byte-identical. A separate uninstrumented overflow CLI control also passes. The unchanged Access workflow retains emitter-before-upload ordering and both `if: always()` conditions; no new hosted Access overflow/upload job is claimed.

## Measured tests and Hosted evidence

- Actual Python **3.12.14**, environment-loaded SQLite **3.53.1**, no SQLite acquisition/replacement/matrix.
- Related existing pytest: **280 passed, 57 subtests passed**, zero failures/errors/skips, exit 0. Exact collection/start/JUnit identities, phase outcomes, session/process exit and **458 unchanged execution-input hashes** reconcile. These reruns are distinct from the independent experiment.
- Repository Ruff lint/format, SQLite-policy, review helper lint/format and prose checks pass.
- Existing [#139 development run 39887549016](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/39887549016) independently reread: both jobs Success. Actual merge parents and reviewed feature tree verify; **71,313-byte** log receipt, SHA-256 `ecd164beb7edfed98a97c342684590ae926b405630c21e88aaa2bca2945b52bb`, all **21 indexed members** verify.
- This review actually retrieved artifact **12472429473** through the supported connector/file reference, **HTTP 200**, **71,124 bytes**, SHA-256 `d43c9ea6d19dd3744b6b44778ba015cde281e8a8e5ae766b3591039a4d080cb1`, matching live GitHub metadata. All **20 shared files** match the receipt. Historical Author-side 403 is preserved as history; no restriction was bypassed.
- Hosted manifest: `development_checks_passed`, `full_acceptance=false`, **product pytest 0**, **212 required files unexecuted**. Development Success does not establish product acceptance.

Failed reviewer calibration/trace attempts and their logs remain, separate from the final passing observations. Raw GitHub log whitespace is preserved losslessly in gzip, with decompressed hashes; the final full diff passes whitespace validation.

## Limits and publication

Historical **79 non-success nodes (59 failures + 20 setup errors)** are not rerun, resolved, reclassified or accepted here. Full product suite, Access/I4/I5 runtime, installed wheel/sdist, live acquisition and release qualification remain unexecuted in this review. No merge, release, deployment, existing branch rewrite or product correction was performed. There is no remaining scoped-publication blocker.

## Verified review publication CI

[Development run 39930570430, attempt 1](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/39930570430) completed **Success**, both `offline` and `sqlite-policy`. Its actual checkout `a37372ce38de0209afb5d6175d28844908370d2b` has ordered parents #139 HEAD / this feature HEAD, and exactly this feature tree `9c220c6606703aa36606896eb52d0a8966914a36`.

The normal run-log ZIP was freshly retrieved and the actual timestamped receipt independently verified with the submitted `verify_hosted.py`: **72,133 bytes**, SHA-256 `a132bf4ec091427aeee127f4d1789b54b091e2d80c7156798374ab569dd35364`, all **21 indexed members** and BEGIN/DATA/END/run/attempt/feature/checkout/tree binding pass. Manifest: `development_checks_passed`, `full_acceptance=false`, **product pytest 0**, **212 required files unexecuted**. No separate download of this review run's artifact was needed or claimed. This verifies publication infrastructure, while the independent local 280-node evidence retains its own source/runtime binding.

Final live API checks confirm Draft #147 remains open, directly based on unchanged #139, with publication HEAD/tree recorded above. No existing PR was modified or merged.
